text:
deploy-bot: initiating percent rollout v4.1.2 -> 8% eu-north (commit f7c3d2e)
deploy-bot: release-notes: https://ci.redwood/release/4.1.2 — routing change + batch/autoscale tweak
rhea: first 60s: small but consistent p95 increase in eu-north, p99 shows two spikes
marc: 5xx steady but elevated 0.6% -> 1.2% on a handful of hosts
jess: traces show longer latency for long-prompt sessions, also increased reclaims on k8s node 14
infra-bot: note: autoscaler cooldown changed from 60s -> 20s in commit f7c3d2e (PR #8123)
rhea: that could explain churn; autoscale too eager causing cold hosts
marc: suggest pause region and pin back to v4.1.1 for eu-north only; keep other regions at 8%
ops-bot: command plan:
```
redwood rollout set --commit f7c3d2e --region eu-north --percent 0 --reason "pause: autoscaler churn"
redwood route set --region eu-north --from v4.1.2 --to v4.1.1 --force
```
deploy-bot: executed at 4601234578, eu-north v4.1.2 -> 0%
rhea: metrics: p95/p99 back to baseline within 30s, node pressure easing :thumbsup:
jess: capture replay: s3://canary-replays/4601234567/eu-north-autoscale.tar.gz
marc: follow-ups: revert autoscale cooldown in a hotfix, add a small-bake with churny autoscale settings, and add a metric guard for node reclaim rate
ops-bot: release notes updated: "eu-north partial rollout paused and region pinned pending autoscaler coolant fix"
rhea: decision: regional pause + pin. no global rollback. i'll own the hotfix PR and target a small-bake in 24h
deploy-bot: thread closed at 4601234589
